# Dockerfile Mixin

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `dockerfile.base` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/docker.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, dockerfile, abstract |

Variable surface for definitions that emit a `Dockerfile`. Provides
`dockerfile_body` (the rendered Dockerfile contents), `image_tag` (the
tag to use when building), and `build_context` (the directory passed to
`docker build`). This mixin is typically composed into `docker.base`
alongside `compose.base`; it does not add run blocks of its own.

Children that do not need a Dockerfile leave `dockerfile_body` empty;
the scaffolding loop in `folder.base` rejects empty entries via
`rejectattr`, so no empty file is written.
